name: Vigilante's Reflexes
body:
Vigilante's Reflexes (Ex)
Source Antihero's Handbook pg. 17
The vigilante gains Combat Reflexes as a bonus feat. If he already has the Combat Reflexes feat, he instead gains another feat he qualified for at the level when he chose Combat Reflexes. At 8th and 16th levels, the number of additional attacks of opportunity per round the vigilante can make increases by 1, regardless of the vigilante’s Dexterity bonus.
